description: The map's messages: the keys by message number from "first" (the numbers before it are common.json's), and the English text of the original game.

strings.map7_s00.something_you_said_before_has:
{wait1 2.8}Something you said before
has been bothering me.
strings.map7_s00.i_just_cant_get_it: {wait1 2.6}I just can't get it out of my head.
strings.map7_s00.so_i_went_to_look:
{wait1 2.5}So I went to look
in the basement.
strings.map7_s00.even_though_i_was_scared:
{wait1 3.0}Even though I was scared
as hell.
strings.map7_s00.like_you_said_there_were:
{wait1 3.1}Like you said,
there were these creepy rooms.
strings.map7_s00.but_while_i_was_down:
{wait1 3.6}But while I was down there,
I got this weird feeling.
strings.map7_s00.like_something_happened_there:
{wait1 5.0}Like something happened there,
but I can't quite remember
somehow.
strings.map7_s00.im_so_scared_i_cant:
{wait 3.2}I'm so scared.
I can't take this.
strings.map7_s00.youre_in_shock_from_when:
{wait 2.7}You're in shock from
when you were knocked out.
strings.map7_s00.dont_fret_about_it_youll:
{wait 2.7}Don't fret about it,
you'll remember after a while...{end}
strings.map7_s00.from_down_there_its_coming:
{wait 4.0}From down there...
It's coming from the basement...{end}
strings.map7_s00.what_could_be_making_things:
{wait 2.7}What could be making things
like this?
strings.map7_s00.i_have_a_feeling_if:
{wait 4.3}I have a feeling if I take
the elevator down I'll find it.{end}
